intent:
"yes approbe and begin the implementation" started the bstack build slice by slice, strictly one at a time ("keep it sequential"). Later: "i'm only not concerned about security hardening, threat-model concerns. Style and simplification and following proper design principles are still important." - build the full app fast, but review the core properly so slices and phases do not leave bugs.

The plans of record are in the repo: `docs/design.md` (requirements and decisions, including R24: licensing is out of scope) and `docs/implementation-plan.md` (tasks, task evidence contract). knowttl/bstack is public, has no GitHub Actions or workflows and no release automation, and ships through the no-mistakes pipeline (`.no-mistakes.yaml` owns the review budget and focus) with automatic merge of green work. Landed: Phase 0, T1.1-T1.3 and T1.4 (https://github.com/knowttl/bstack/pull/17: interview and domain-language references). The merged slice table combines C9b and C10a as C9b10a, preserving both task IDs and the union of their done evidence.

This piece is merged slice C9b10a (old C9b + C10a): task T1.5 "Adapt VISION and bundle the board assets", then the first part of task T1.6 "Build the VISION board launcher" - the runtime research and live probe, the exact pin with its nested lockfile and gate setup, and the `vision-board build` subcommand. Merged done evidence: package check and recorded asset/NOTICE diff; clean nested install, runtime observation, safe inserted text, unique IDs. The `launch` and `verdicts` subcommands, the resumed review and the manual board run are C10b.
amendments: README, command/runtime documentation and Progress were updated before final implementation validation. This evidence-only commit records those runs.
F13 read from the approved commissioning report: deterministic run/draft/card binding belongs to the launcher, semantic draft revision belongs to the agent.

commands.reason: Exit 1 is the expected recorded adaptation diff, reviewed against NOTICE.

cases.procedure: Registered package-check tests and generated-board suite verify installed resource closure and unchanged shipped CSS through the public command.

Compared template and stylesheet to pinned upstream. Stylesheet diff is empty. Template diff contains only NOTICE-recorded slot instructions, removal of comment title tag, JSON draft and REVIEW slot, text escaping and run/draft metadata with namespaced queue keys. Reviewed adapted reference for author evidence, real-trade-off proposal count, existing-vision delta and protected scratch boundary.

limitations: Local runs exercised Linux and Node 24 only. No other OS or Node version was tested in this slice.
Structural reference review does not prove model interpretation. No new agent evaluation or real author approval was performed.
